title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin

extraction.summaryEn: Around 6:45 a.m., a man allegedly struck several election posters with a pole at a junction in Märkisches Viertel, was arrested after boarding a bus, and the posters were damaged. The State Security unit is investigating; the case is one of several election-related vandalism reports on this day.
